sourceRefs.locator: pp. 177–180, domestic drainage, street drains and wedge-shaped bricks used in round wells.
Abstract, broad Indus urban phase around 2600–1900 BCE and discussion of collective action and political organization.

summary.de: Stadtruine im heutigen Sindh in Pakistan. In den ausgegrabenen Vierteln sind viele Brunnen und gemauerte Abflüsse erhalten.
summary.en: Urban ruins in present-day Sindh, Pakistan. Many wells and brick drains survive in the excavated districts.
